The '''Markaran Plains''' were a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. The [[Jacent Valley]] was located in the plains, and both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Balmorran resistance]] maintained several outposts in the area at various points during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|battle]] for control of the planet.
